Market notes, October 2026: Toronto vs. York Region

Sales and prices were down from a year ago, and buyers had more choice. Here's how the two sides of Steeles compare.

Ali Bayat
Figures checked against the sources below on November 21, 2026
Published November 21, 2026
2-minute readTRREB dataReleased November 4, 2026

04What it means

Buyers

More choice, more time

Inventory is up and prices are lower than last year. Conditions on financing and inspection are realistic again.

Sellers

Price for today

Buyers are comparing. Price from recent sales, not last year's peak, and prepare the home well.

Investors

Rates moved up

The Bank of Canada raised its rate to 2.5% on October 28. Re-run cash flow at today's rates.

Ali's take

Averages hide a lot. Semis are still selling over asking while condos sit, so look at your property type and street before you decide anything.
